name: Firespark Trap (3-4) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
description: Magical motion sensors detect when a creature enters the chamber.
disable: DC 20 Thievery (trained) to disable the sensor without triggering them, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the sensors

generalAbilities.name: Firespark
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the chamber

Effect The rune detonates in a ball of flame that fills the chamber, dealing 4d6 Fire Damage damage to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save).
